:::{#rem-hat-matrix-name}
#### Why it is called the hat matrix

The hat matrix gives the fitted values in linear regression:

$$
\begin{aligned}
\hat{\vy} &= \mX\hvcoef \\
&= \mX(\tp{\mX}\mX)^{-1}\tp{\mX}\vy \\
&= \matr{H}\vy.
\end{aligned}
$$

Multiplying by $\matr{H}$ "puts a hat" on $\vy$,
which is where the name comes from.
In @exm-hat-matrix, $\matr{H}$ puts a hat on $\vy$
by replacing each $y_i$ with the sample mean $\bar{y}$.

:::
